module: Manages the Track Builder edit markers (bank, height, width, checkpoint, left and right walls, ceiling) and the interpolation of the values they carry along the track. Markers are TSStatic objects created and moved in the scene (canSave = false). Each marker type declares in an internal 'types' table its interpolation mode ('points', 'segments', 'both' or 'single'), its field interpolation function and its marker placement function. The module also computes the start and end caps between neighboring segments.
notes: The interpolation functions (step, linear, pow2, pow3, pow4, smoothSlope, smootherSlope) take t in [0, 1] and return two values: the interpolated value and its derivative. smoothSlope and smootherSlope have a horizontal derivative at both ends. The interpolation names stored in the markers (b.interpolation) are the names of these functions of M.
Marker values are written into the segment's points (point.bank, point.width, point.height…) and into segment.markerInfo; segment.refreshMesh is set to true when the mesh must be regenerated.

Only the types listed in names (bank, height, width, checkpoint, leftWall, rightWall, ceilingMesh) have a marker list; the names centerMesh, leftMesh and rightMesh are commented out in names, so hideMarkers/clearMarkers/unloadAll do not handle them (hideMarkers('centerMesh') would cause an error on a nil table).
Bug: in linear/pow2/pow3/pow4, the derivative returned for t >= 1 is t, 2t, 3t, 4t instead of the derivative at 1 (1, 2, 3, 4 for t=1); the value is correct only if t is exactly 1.
Bug: in compareSimpleCaps and compareWallCeilingCaps, the 'noPoints' branches test second.startCap / first.endCap (segment fields) instead of meshInfo[nameOfField].startCap / endCap.
Bug: in interpolateOverSegments, the condition 'i ~= track' compares a number to a table (always true).
A width marker consists of two TSStatic objects (named 'widthMarker<n>' and 'widthMarker<n>b').

names.desc: List of handled marker types: bank, height, width, checkpoint, leftWall, rightWall, ceilingMesh.

step.desc: Step interpolation: always returns 0 and 0 (the start value is kept).

linear.desc: Linear interpolation: value t, derivative 1 (0 outside [0, 1] on the left, 1 on the right).

smoothSlope.desc: Smooth interpolation (3t²-2t³): goes from 0 to 1 with a horizontal slope at 0 and at 1.

smootherSlope.desc: Even smoother interpolation (Perlin polynomial 6t⁵-15t⁴+10t³), zero slope and curvature at the ends.

interpolate.desc: Interpolates the field nameOfField over the whole track according to the type's mode ('points', 'segments', 'both' or 'single'), then clears the change list for that field.

interpolateOverPoints.desc: Interpolates between two successive marker values on the points of the relevant segments (only if they are in markerChanges or fresh), according to the distance traveled.

interpolateOverSegments.desc: Applies the previous marker value to each segment ('segments' mode), starting from the first segment that carries the field.

interpolateSingle.desc: For 'single' types (checkpoint), calls the segment function only for the indices registered by addMarkerChange.

interpolatePointsOfSegment.desc: Interpolates between startValue and endValue on a segment's points (fraction t = (p.length - startLength)/(endLength - startLength)) and on its markerInfo; without points, only computes markerInfo. Sets refreshMesh to true.

endValue.desc: End value; nil to keep startValue.

interpolateField.desc: Delegates to the type-specific interpolation function (for example interpolateBank, interpolateWidth) to write the interpolated value into point.

point.desc: Point or markerInfo to write to.

caps.desc: Computes the start and end caps between consecutive segments for centerMesh, leftMesh, rightMesh (if the values differ), and for leftWall, rightWall, ceilingMesh (if the active state differs). Segment 1 is skipped; if closed is true, the last segment is compared to the second.

transformMarkers.desc: Creates, deletes and repositions the marker objects of the given type for the track's nodes; has no effect if the type has no transformMarkers function.

allNodes.desc: All the nodes/segments of the track.

hideMarkers.desc: Hides the markers of the given type by setting their scale to 0.

clearMarkers.desc: Removes the markers of the given type from the scene.

addMarkerChange.desc: Notes that the segment at index index has a modified marker for the field name; interpolate then recomputes only the affected zones.

index.desc: Index of the segment in the track.

unloadAll.desc: Forgets all marker lists (reset to {}) without deleting the objects from the scene; use after a scene cleanup.
